    feat(sandbox): add C3 filesystem ACL layer via icacls (deny-write + allow-write + restore)
    
    Implements the third Windows sandbox milestone: applies deny-write ACEs
    
    for Everyone (S-1-1-0) on readonly_root and allow-write ACEs on
    
    writable_paths via icacls CLI. Saves original ACLs to temp files for
    
    restore_path_policy to put back after the child exits.
    
    Approach: uses icacls CLI instead of raw Win32 Security API because
    
    ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW was unresolved
    
    in windows 0.58 without Win32_Security_Authorization feature, and icacls
    
    is INCREMENTAL (adds ACEs to existing ACL, preserves existing ACEs)
    
    which is better than SDDL replace-all-DACL for v1.
    
    Also adds Win32_Security_Authorization feature to Cargo.toml for the
    
    broker sub-plan that will eventually use the raw Authorization API.
    
    Not wired into the spawner: the broker sub-plan (C2-broker) will call
    
    apply_path_policy before spawn and restore_path_policy after child exit.
    
    is_enforced() stays false on Windows.
